Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting general power of attorney provisions in bail bond agreements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting general power of attorney provisionsin bail bond agreements; and adding a new section to chapter 18.185RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.185 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Entering into a contract, including a general power of attorney,that gives a bail bond agent full authority over a person's finances,assets, real property, or personal property creates a presumption ofunprofessional conduct that may be overcome by a preponderance of theevidence presented to the department to the contrary. The departmenthas the discretion to determine whether or not the bail bond agency oragent has overcome the presumption and if unprofessional conduct wascommitted.
